customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out regarding your eProcurement approval workflows. To check and adjust your approval workflow levels, tenant administrators can follow these steps (KB-5638):
1. Navigate to Setup and Configuration > eProcurement Administration > Approval Workflows.
2. Review the routing rules, threshold limits, and conditional approver lists to ensure they are optimized for your volume.
3. If specific approvers are experiencing delays due to absence, you can also set up out-of-office delegations by opening your profile menu, selecting Out of Office, choosing a delegate with the same or higher approval limit, and setting the start and end dates (KB-4449).

Please let us know if you need any further assistance configuring these settings!

Best regards,
Zycus Support
